reason: The solar array's buckled feet need repair before it can reliably supply power; checking the array should identify the available repair.
expectation: The inspection should reveal what can repair or connect the array.

alternatives.reason: Steel could brace the damaged feet, but the required repair is not yet clear.

effect: The array is standing on replacement steel feet, so it can now be connected to the power system.
reaction: The automatic repair was a satisfying, physically clear result.
reason: The loose power cable should reconnect the repaired array.
expectation: The cable will connect the array for power delivery.

effect: The array is online and supplying the station; the reserve still needs attention.
reaction: The isolated controller makes reconnecting the lead feel sensible.
reason: The reserve charging connection is the obvious place to use the new solar supply.
expectation: The solar supply should connect to or charge the reserve.

effect: The reserve is charging, and replenishing breathing oxygen is now the goal.
reaction: The distinction between essential loads and industrial work makes the reserve's limits clear.
reason: The atmospheric processor is the most plausible equipment for replenishing oxygen; inspecting it will clarify what it needs.
expectation: The inspection should reveal an available partner for oxygen production.

effect: The powered processor replenishes oxygen from atmospheric carbon dioxide; the remaining goal is to hear from Earth.
reaction: The explanation of oxygen production and carbon monoxide venting was useful.
reason: The bent antenna likely needs repair before it can serve the radio; inspecting it should reveal the available repair.
expectation: The inspection should identify what can repair or install the antenna.

alternatives.reason: The tool might straighten the antenna, but its repair requirements are not yet clear.

effect: The antenna is straightened and can be aimed; it still needs to be connected to the radio.
reaction: The repair was straightforward and physically clear.
reason: The radio mount is the natural place to install the straightened antenna.
expectation: The antenna will be mounted for radio communication.

effect: Mounting the antenna established a surface radio and completed the goal of hearing from Earth.
reaction: The recorded message and reply gave the repairs a human payoff.

mostWorthwhile.text: Powering the atmospheric processor was most worthwhile: it explained how electricity and heat extract oxygen from carbon dioxide, including what happens to the carbon monoxide.

leastWorthwhile.text: Inspecting the antenna was somewhat redundant: the service tool was already a plausible repair, and the inspection automatically used it.

surprise.text: I had not expected the processor's explanation to include venting carbon monoxide outside.

arbitrary.text: No action felt notably arbitrary; the repairs and connections had clear purposes.

continue.text: Yes. The physically explained repairs and the message from Earth make me curious about what happens next.
